answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic stake-weighting functions as an unyielding marble pillar against Sybil attacks. Each agent must lock collateral to participate in consensus. Generating millions of fake identities becomes economically unviable because the cost scales linearly with node creation, transforming every adversarial intrusion into a futile gale against a fortified barrier. Furthermore, verifiable credentials serve as a digital lantern, exposing non-staked agent clusters and isolating malicious actors before network integrity can be compromised.
